annotations.title: Deck framing calculator (joists, beam, posts, footings, boards)

description: Deck framing calculator (joists, beam, posts, footings, boards) — Deck framing and materials estimator. Required: width_ft (along the house) and depth_ft (out from the house). Optional: species (pine | fir | cedar, default pine), spacing_in (12 | 16 | 24, default 16), attached (true | false, default true = ledger on the house), cantilever_ft (default 0), height_ft (default 3), soil_psf (default 1500), frost_in (default 36), post_spacing_ft (default: widest that works, up to 8), decking (wood | composite). Returns joist size from IRC R507.6 span table values with the options list, joist count, built-up beam sized by bending + L/360 deflection with the check numbers, intermediate beam when the span is too long, 6x6 post count and stock length, footing diameter from tributary load and soil bearing plus 80 lb concrete bags, decking rows/boards/screws, hangers, ties, ledger fasteners, guard requirement and code notes. Offline preliminary estimate, not a stamped design. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_deck
